नखैर्विदारितांश्चान्यान्.en: by claws; torn apart; and; others

नदीपुलिनमास्थितः.en: a river's sandy bank; settled on, stayed

ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः.en: danced; and; troupes of apsarases / danced; and; the hosts of Apsarases

नागाधीश्वरविष्टरां.en: whose seat is the lord of serpents

नादापूरितदिङ्मुखा.en: filling the quarters with her roar / (with) the quarters filled with sound

निजगात्रासृगुक्षितम्.en: sprinkled with blood from their own bodies (nija-gātra-asṛk-ukṣita)

निजघण्टास्वनेन.en: with the sound of her own bell

निर्जिताखिलदैत्यारिः.en: who has conquered all enemies of the Daityas
